subject: TerraForge security call — run-of-show, artifact queue & logistics
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Carter <leah.carter@terraforge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: TerraForge security call — run-of-show, artifact queue & logistics

Hi Leah —

Thanks for booking time with us next week. Wanted to share a concise run-of-show and the minimal set of artifacts we need before the call so we can make the 45-minute window productive:

Agenda (45 min):
- 0–5 min: Introductions & scope confirmation (host: Tessa)
- 5–20 min: Architecture overview and data flows (TerraForge)
- 20–35 min: Focused Q&A on logs, access patterns, and retention (Marcus/Irene)
- 35–45 min: Action items, owners, and timelines

Pre-call artifact queue (please upload to the shared folder or S3 link by EOD 2026-07-05):
1) One week of anonymized application logs (gzip) with timestamps — sample window preferred: most recent 7 days (Owner: Marco/TF ops).
2) Short doc with IAM roles and SCIM/SSO configuration (Owner: TF security).
3) KMS key policy snapshot and rotation cadence (Owner: TF infra).
4) Network diagram (VPCs, peering, proxies) and egress destinations (Owner: TF infra).

For our side: Marcus will prepare an example log ingestion schema and a tiny helper script; Irene will bring the SOC 2 evidence checklist so we can map gaps live.

Attachments: run_of_show.pdf (application/pdf) — single-page run-of-show and checklist.

Quick asks: can you confirm the TF attendee list (names & emails) and whether the logs will be made available as a pre-signed S3 URL or via Drive? Also let us know if you need an NDA/POA scanned copy before we accept sample logs.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
T +1 (415) 555-0116
Attachment: run_of_show.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Leah Carter <leah.carter@terraforge.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@terraforge.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: TerraForge security call — run-of-show, artifact queue & logistics

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear agenda and list — this is great. We'll get the items into the folder and confirm attendees by Thursday. A couple of quick clarifications: 

- Log window: we can provide the last 14 days if that helps; we can also filter out PII server-side. Do you need 7 or 14 days?
- Format: our ops team can drop gzipped JSONL to a pre-signed S3 URL (preferred) or to Drive. S3 is fine for us.
- KMS: we can export a policy snapshot and an excerpt of rotation logs (redacted).

I'll get Marco (TF ops) to prepare the S3 link and a short README. Upload ETA: 2026-07-03.

Attachments: tf_access_instructions.txt (text/plain) — brief note on how we provision access and the person to ping on the TF side.

People joining:
- Leah Carter (leah.carter@terraforge.com) — Security PM
- Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@terraforge.com) — Ops lead
- Priya Suresh (pri.suresh@terraforge.com) — Infra (tentative)

Would you like us to include a short recording link with the uploads or keep the folder closed until the call?

Best,
Leah

--- quoted below ---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Carter <leah.carter@terraforge.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TerraForge security call — run-of-show, artifact queue & logistics

Leah —

7 days is sufficient for our log sample; if you can do 14 days that helps, but we'll work with 7 if that's easier. A few specifics so the sample is immediately usable:

- Preferred format: gzipped JSONL with one JSON object per line. If you must send syslog, include a parse key mapping.
- Fields we care about: timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, user_agent (redact if PII), path, response_code, latency_ms.
- Please include a short README.txt with the sample describing timezone and any internal ID mapping.

I attached a tiny schema we use and a 40-line Python sniff script that will validate format and strip IPs if needed. Attachment: log_sample_schema.json (application/json)

I'll take ownership of verifying the sample once it's uploaded; I'll post back any follow-up asks before the call so we keep the meeting focused on compliance mapping.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Carter <leah.carter@terraforge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@terraforge.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: TerraForge security call — run-of-show, artifact queue & logistics

Thanks all — quick meeting minute / confirmation: 

1) Upload plan: TerraForge will provide a pre-signed S3 URL with a README; ETA 2026-07-03. Marcus will validate sample and flag anything missing by 2026-07-04.
2) Artifacts requested: logs (7–14 days gzipped JSONL), IAM/SSO snapshot, KMS policy snapshot, network diagram. Marco/TF ops will upload; Leah to confirm owner names.
3) Call time: confirmed for 2026-07-07 14:00 PT (45 minutes). Calendar invite to follow.
4) On-call owners during the call: Marcus (log validation), Irene (SOC 2 mapping & questions), Tessa (overall facilitation).
5) No NDA required for sample logs if they are redacted and uploaded to the S3 pre-signed URL; TerraForge confirmed redaction will happen client-side.

Action items (short):
- Leah: upload artifacts + README to S3 link by 2026-07-03.
- Marcus: validate sample and confirm schema by 2026-07-04.
- Irene: prepare SOC 2 control checklist and map to the requested artifacts before the call.
- Tessa: circulate final agenda and the short list of follow-up deliverables after the meeting.

If anything changes on attendees or the upload plan, please flag by Friday 2026-07-02 so we can re-prioritize.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
Attachment: none
